title: I or Us
setup.heading: The village
setup.intro: Set up the population, then start time and watch what happens.
setup.compositionHelp: “I ← → Us” is what a villager would do if nobody were watching: keep everything, or give everything to the group. “Watches others” is how much they base their conduct on what they believe others do. The two profiles are not groups: nobody knows which profile anyone else belongs to, and they blend from the first generation.
setup.pondHelp: With the large pond, fish renew fast enough that it never dies. With the small one, a village that fishes without restraint can empty it; villagers who hold back keep it alive.
setup.sanctionsHelp: A villager can pay a little to make another, who gives clearly less than the others to the granary, lose more.
setup.pondSanctionsHelp: A villager can pay a little to make another, who fishes clearly more than the others, lose more.
setup.seedHelp: The same seed and the same settings give exactly the same game.

home.heading: Enter the village
home.lead: Two ways in: live a life there, or set it up and watch.
home.life.title: Live a life
home.life.text: You are 15 and live with your parent. Walk around, talk to the villagers, carry your harvest to the granary, fish at the pond. Five chapters, from 15 to 55; between them, ten years go by quickly. No goal is given.
home.village.free: With 15% of villagers who keep everything
home.watch.title: Set up a village and watch
home.watch.text: Choose the population and the rules, start time and watch what emerges, generation after generation.
life.prompt.granary: E: carry your {sacks} sacks to the granary
life.prompt.granaryDone: You have already been to the granary this season.
life.prompt.granaryYoung: The common granary: adults give part of their harvest here.
life.prompt.pondDone: You have already fished this season.
life.prompt.home: E: go home and sleep until next season

life.prompt.fieldYoung: The field: you will work here at 16.

life.talk.parentIntro1: Look at you, all grown up. At 16 you will work your own plot in the field, and decide for yourself what to do with it.
life.talk.parentIntro2: The field is to the north, the granary in the middle of the village, the pond to the east. Follow me if you want to see.
life.talk.orphan: I’m {name}. I have lived alone since my parent died.
life.talk.childWork: I will work in the field when I turn {age}.
life.talk.willGive: This season I harvested {harvest} sacks. I will carry {given} to the granary.
life.talk.gave: This season I harvested {harvest} sacks and gave {given} to the granary.
life.talk.hungry: I have nothing left. I have been hungry for {n} season(s).
life.talk.fined: I was fined last season: I lost {lost}.
life.talk.chief.none: I am the village chief. For now, no sanctions are allowed.
life.talk.chief.granary: I am the village chief. Sanctions are allowed at the granary, not at the pond.
life.talk.chief.pond: I am the village chief. Sanctions are allowed at the pond, not at the granary.
life.talk.chief.both: I am the village chief. Sanctions are allowed at the granary and at the pond.
life.talk.seesYou: I see what you do: last season you gave {given} sacks out of {harvest}.
life.talk.seesYouYoung: Your house is next to mine: I will see what you do once you work.
life.talk.youSee: {name} is one of the neighbours you watch: what you believe about others comes from what you see them do.
life.talk.sanctionHelp: This season {name} gives clearly less than the others. Sanctioning costs you {cost}; the fine takes {fine} from them. The engine only applies it under the same conditions as for everyone.
life.talk.sanctionWanted: You have decided to sanction them: you will know at the end of the season whether it happened.
life.granary.title: The common granary
life.granary.harvest: You harvested {sacks} sacks. How many do you carry to the granary?
life.granary.rule: Everything given is multiplied by {mult}, then shared equally among the {adults} adults, whether or not each gave. Your share: {share}. It becomes your line of conduct until you change it.
life.granary.neighbors: Already here this season, around you: {list}.
life.granary.nobodyYet: Nobody around you has been to the granary yet this season.
life.granary.first: Your first harvest. Nobody tells you how much to give.
life.granary.keys: ← → to change, Enter to give, Esc to leave without deciding.
life.pond.title: The pond
life.pond.rule: Each cast adds a fifth of the maximum effort: {max} casts means fishing as much as you can. Your effort: {effort}. The catch is at most {catch} fish when the pond is full, and drops with it; you will know it at the end of the season.
life.pond.first: Fish come back faster when enough of them are left.
life.pond.keys: E to cast, Enter to stop, Esc to leave without deciding.
life.sleep.title: Go home
life.sleep.text: Sleep until next season? The engine then works out the season.
life.sleep.warn: You have not been to the granary: your line of conduct will apply.

life.open.title: Age {age}
life.open.home: You live with {parent}, your parent, in a village of {n} people.
life.open.adult: At {age} you will work in the field, then decide what you give to the common granary and how you fish at the pond.
life.open.goal: No goal is given. Walk around, talk to the villagers: arrow keys or WASD to walk (or click), E to talk or act.
life.between.title: End of the chapter
life.between.next: Ten years will pass. The next chapter starts at {age}.
life.between.last: Time will pass until the end of your life.
life.conduct.shareNeighbors: At the granary: like your neighbours.
life.conduct.shareValue: At the granary: {sacks}/10 of your harvest.
life.conduct.fishNeighbors: At the pond: like your neighbours.
life.conduct.fishValue: At the pond: {casts} casts out of {max}.
life.conduct.title: Your line of conduct
life.conduct.help: It applies every season you do not go to the granary or the pond yourself, and while time passes between chapters. “Like your neighbours”: you do what you believe they do.
life.chapter.quiet: Ten quiet years: nothing serious in your family.
life.chapter.state: Your reserve: {wealth}. The village has {n} people; the pond is {pond}% full.
life.chapter.neighbor: {name}: “I give {now}/10 of my harvest now. I gave {before}/10 when you were {age}.”
life.chapter.newNeighbor: {name}, your neighbour now: “I give {now}/10 of my harvest.”
life.chapter.grownChild: {name}, your child: “I give {now}/10 of my harvest.”
life.neighbors.title: Your neighbourhood
life.neighbors.rule: Everyone only sees their {k} closest neighbours on the ring of houses, and bases what they believe about others on them. An eye above a villager: you watch them.
life.neighbors.share: last season, {given} sacks given out of {harvest}
life.neighbors.young: Nobody watches what you do yet: you are not working.
life.help.title: Help
life.help.move: Walk: arrow keys or WASD, or click where you want to go.
life.help.act: E, Space, or a tap on the prompt at the bottom of the screen: talk to a nearby villager, carry your harvest to the granary, fish at the pond, go to sleep at your door. Click a villager: go and talk to them.
life.help.season: A season lasts {s} seconds on foot; time stops during conversations.
life.help.chapters: Chapters at ages {ages}, about {years} year each; the first lasts until the end of your first adult year.
life.help.casts: At the pond, {max} casts = the engine’s maximum effort.
life.help.sacks: At the granary, one sack = one unit of food; your share = sacks given / sacks harvested.
life.help.cooldown: The same card (sanction, hunger) comes back at most every {n} seasons.
life.help.engine: These settings do not change the engine: the gesture sets your decision, the engine works out the result, with the same rules for everyone. The rules and their sources are in the lab.
life.death.title: The end of a life
life.death.starved: Your life ends at {age}, for lack of food.
life.death.heirs: Your reserve, {wealth}, is shared among your {n} children.
life.death.noHeirs: Your reserve, {wealth}, is lost: you have no living child.
life.epilogue.title: After you
life.epilogue.lineage: {years} years after your death: {n} villagers, {heirs} of them your descendants, who give {heirShare}/10 of their harvest on average. In the village people give {share}/10 ({start}/10 when you died). The pond is {pond}% full.
life.epilogue.noLineage: {years} years after your death: {n} villagers, none of them your descendants. In the village people give {share}/10 of their harvest ({start}/10 when you died). The pond is {pond}% full.
life.epilogue.question: What remains of a life: children, an example, rules?
life.epilogue.replay: Live another life in this village
